main_text.l: mana beneuolentia,prudentia & potentia fpem ponamus : fed in Deo uiuo, qui eft φιλανθρωπος, οἰκτιρμων, omnipotens & uerax.

Commemorabile exemplum fæuitiæ & uanitatis, qua interdum homo hominem profequitur, exftat in hiftoria Leonis Magni Imperatoris,cuius imperij anno 1o Ifocafius, Antiocheæ quæftor, homo literatus,per calumniam delatus eft, quafi qui alienus à religione & pietate Chriftiana,Ethnicifmo clàm effet addictus. Imperator totius rei cognitionem Pofæo Conftantinopoleos præfecto demandat. Is collegæ quondam fuo,manibus poft tergum reuinctis, habituq; lugubri ad tribunal adducto, farcafmo infultans, dixit: Videsne Ifocafi quo habitu adftes? Respondit ille: Ὁπῶ, ἀλλὰ ἡ ἐγκλίομαι[?] ἄνθρωπος γὰρ ὤν, ἀνθρωπίνοις πορίζεσθαι συμ-[?] φορὰς. ἀλλὰ ἀδίκως ἐπ᾽ ἐμοί, ὡς ἐδίκαις σύ ἐ-[?] μοί. Hoc eft: Video, neque miror. homo enim in calamitatem incidi humanam. Tu uero ita mihi iius dicito, ficut me collega folebas dicere. Tandem recognita, absolutus eft Ifocafius, magno cum circumstantis coronæ gaudio.

page.notes: The Greek sentence after "Respondit ille:" is only partly legible in this scan (small, blurred type). The words marked [?] are a best reading and not certain; the accents and several letters could be wrong. The line break after "συμ-" and the word "φορὰς" are inferred from the printed hyphen and the line end. The "1o" in "anno 1o" is printed as a lowercase o and is kept as printed. Catchword "Serpen-" is at the foot right.
